pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: A photographer working slowly and in natural light, between the coast and the studio — portraiture, landscape and still life, printed in small editions.

children: I am a photographer working in portrait, landscape and still life. I make pictures slowly and in the light that is already there — I would rather wait an hour for the weather than change it afterwards.

My work moves between the coast and the studio: long series made outdoors over a season, and quieter still lifes built from ordinary things on a windowsill. Whatever the subject, I am after the same moment — when a scene settles and goes still enough to hold.

I shoot on film and digital, print in editions, and take on a small number of portrait and editorial commissions each year. Work has appeared in independent journals and gallery shows across the north.
